ejercicios.instruccion: Completa con el pasado simple. Casi todos los verbos son irregulares: no llevan -ed.
ejercicios.texto: Last Monday was a disaster. I {1} (wake) up late because my phone {2} (die) during the night. I {3} (take) a quick shower, {4} (put) on the first shirt I {5} (find) and {6} (run) to the corner. Of course, there {7} (be) no taxis. I {8} (get) to the office at ten, sweaty and angry, and the meeting was already over. My boss just looked at me and smiled.
ejercicios.explica: Una secuencia de acciones terminadas → pasado simple. Irregulares: wake → woke, take → took, put → put, find → found, run → ran, get → got. There + plural → there were.

ejercicios.instruccion: Completa la conversación. En preguntas y negativas aparece did y el verbo vuelve a la base.
ejercicios.texto: Monday morning, in the kitchen. Camila: 'Hey! What {1} (you / do) on the weekend?' Me: 'Not much. I {2} (not / go) out on Saturday because I was tired. On Sunday we {3} (visit) my girlfriend's parents in Chía.' Camila: '{4} (you / eat) a lot?' Me: 'Too much! Gloria {5} (cook) for ten people again.' Camila: 'And {6} (you / see) the game?' Me: 'No, I {7} (not / see) it. Who {8} (win)?'
ejercicios.explica: Did se lleva la marca de pasado: did you do, didn't go, did you see (nunca did you saw). En la afirmativa did se esconde y deja su marca: visited, cooked. Con who como sujeto no hay did: Who won?

ejercicios.instruccion: Elige la forma correcta. Recuerda: una sola marca de pasado por frase.
ejercicios.texto: Last year we {1} for a big account. We {2} three weeks on the idea and we {3} a beautiful film. On the day of the pitch, the client {4} once. They {5} questions about the budget and they {6} our film twice. Two days later, they {7} us with the news: we didn't win. Why {8} we lose? The price. Another agency was cheaper. We still talk about that film.
ejercicios.explica: La marca de pasado aparece una sola vez: o en el verbo (spent, made, asked) o en did (didn't smile, Why did we lose?). Did + verbo con -ed es doble marca: did watched es un error.

ejercicios.instruccion: Completa con el pasado simple. Ojo: be va con was / were y no usa did.
ejercicios.texto: In March I {1} (be) in Cartagena for a shoot. The weather {2} (be) terrible: it {3} (rain) for three days. The actors {4} (not / be) happy, and the director {5} (not / want) to shoot in the rain. On the fourth day the sun {6} (come) out and we {7} (finish) everything in one afternoon. {8} (it / be) stressful? Yes. But the final video looks great. We celebrated with fried fish on the beach that night.
ejercicios.explica: Be tiene su propia llave: was/were, wasn't/weren't, Was it…? Los demás verbos usan did: didn't want. Afirmativa: rained, finished (regulares) y came (irregular).

ejercicios.texto: I met my girlfriend five years ago at a friend's birthday party in Chapinero. I almost didn't go because I felt tired after a long week. I arrived late, around eleven, and I didn't know anybody except my friend. Then she came into the kitchen and asked me for a glass of water. We started talking about music and we didn't stop for three hours. I took her phone number, but I didn't call her the next day. I sent her a message two days later. She replied with one word: 'Finally.'

preguntas.q: Why did he almost stay home?
What did she ask him for?
«I didn't know anybody»: ¿por qué know y no knew?
opciones: Porque didn't ya lleva el pasado y el verbo vuelve a la base

ejercicios.explica: Una historia terminada se cuenta en pasado simple: met, felt, arrived, came, took, sent. Con didn't el verbo vuelve a la base (didn't know, didn't call). Reply → replied: la y pasa a i.

ejercicios.texto: My first job was at a small agency in Medellín. I was twenty-two and I didn't have any experience. On my first day, my boss gave me a brief for a supermarket and said: 'You have until five.' I didn't understand half of the words in the brief, but I didn't ask any questions because I felt embarrassed. I wrote three ideas and presented them at five. My boss read them in silence. Then he said: 'The third one is good. Did you write it alone?' I said yes. It was the first idea I ever sold.

preguntas.q: «Did you write it alone?»: ¿por qué write y no wrote?
opciones: Porque did ya lleva la marca de pasado

preguntas.q: ¿Cuál es el pasado de give en el texto?

ejercicios.explica: Hechos terminados → pasado simple (gave, said, wrote, read). En la pregunta y la negativa did sale a la luz y el verbo queda en base: Did you write…?, I didn't understand.

ejercicios.consigna: Cuenta qué hiciste el fin de semana pasado: al menos tres acciones en orden, algo que no hiciste y una pregunta para tu interlocutor.

requisitos.texto: Usa un verbo irregular en pasado (went, had, saw, slept…)
Ordena con first / then / after that / finally
Incluye una negativa con didn't + verbo base
Haz una pregunta con did you…?

ejercicios.ejemplo: Last weekend was quiet. On Saturday I slept until nine, then I went to the gym and after that I had lunch with my girlfriend in Usaquén. In the afternoon we watched a movie at home. On Sunday we drove to Chía and ate at her parents' house. I didn't work at all, and I didn't check my email once. What did you do on the weekend?
ejercicios.explica: Narrar el fin de semana es una cadena de pasados simples: slept, went, had, watched, drove, ate. Negativa: didn't + base (didn't work, didn't check). Pregunta: What did you do…?

ejercicios.consigna: Cuenta la última presentación importante que hiciste a un cliente: cuándo fue, qué pasó, qué dijo el cliente y cómo terminó.

requisitos.texto: Di cuándo fue (yesterday, last week, two weeks ago…)
Cuenta lo que dijo el cliente con said o told
Usa un verbo irregular en pasado

ejercicios.ejemplo: Two weeks ago we presented a new campaign to the bank. The meeting was at their office and there were eight people in the room. Laura showed the storyboard and I explained the media plan. At first the client didn't say anything, and I felt nervous. Then the marketing director smiled and said: 'This is exactly what we needed.' We left the building at noon and celebrated with a big lunch.
ejercicios.explica: Hechos terminados con un momento claro (two weeks ago) → pasado simple. Be usa was/were; say → said, feel → felt, leave → left. La negativa con did: didn't say.
